daily_production.description: Daily measurements per wellbore, from Equinor's daily production report: hours on stream, pressures, temperatures, choke opening and the volumes produced or injected. One row per `(date, npd_wellbore_code)`. Volumes are in standard cubic metres (Sm³).

columns.name: date
columns.description: Production day (source `DATEPRD`). Stored in the Parquet file as a timestamp at midnight.

columns.name: npd_wellbore_code
columns.description: Wellbore the row belongs to. Joins to `wells`.

columns.name: on_stream_hours
columns.description: Hours the wellbore was producing or injecting that day (`ON_STREAM_HRS`). Up to 25 on the day the clocks go back.

columns.name: avg_downhole_pressure
columns.description: Average pressure at the downhole gauge over the day, in bar (`AVG_DOWNHOLE_PRESSURE`).

columns.name: avg_dp_tubing
columns.description: Average pressure drop along the production tubing, from the downhole gauge to the wellhead, in bar (`AVG_DP_TUBING`).

columns.name: avg_annulus_pressure
columns.description: Average pressure in the annulus between tubing and casing, in bar (`AVG_ANNULUS_PRESS`).

columns.name: avg_wellhead_pressure
columns.description: Average pressure at the wellhead, in bar (`AVG_WHP_P`).

columns.name: avg_downhole_temperature
columns.description: Average temperature at the downhole gauge, in °C (`AVG_DOWNHOLE_TEMPERATURE`).

columns.name: avg_wellhead_temperature
columns.description: Average temperature at the wellhead, in °C (`AVG_WHT_P`).

columns.name: avg_choke_size_percent
columns.description: Average production choke opening, as a percentage of fully open (`AVG_CHOKE_SIZE_P`).

columns.name: avg_choke_unit
columns.description: Unit of `avg_choke_size_percent`: `%`, or NULL on injection rows (`AVG_CHOKE_UOM`).

columns.name: dp_choke_size
columns.description: Pressure drop across the production choke, in bar (`DP_CHOKE_SIZE`).

columns.name: oil_volume
columns.description: Oil produced from the wellbore that day, in Sm³ (`BORE_OIL_VOL`).

columns.name: gas_volume
columns.description: Gas produced from the wellbore that day, in Sm³ (`BORE_GAS_VOL`).

columns.name: water_volume
columns.description: Water produced from the wellbore that day, in Sm³ (`BORE_WAT_VOL`). A few rows are negative, kept as the source reports them.

columns.name: water_injection_volume
columns.description: Water injected into the wellbore that day, in Sm³ (`BORE_WI_VOL`). Filled on injection rows and on a handful of production rows.

columns.name: flow_kind
columns.description: Direction of flow that day: `production` or `injection` (`FLOW_KIND`).

columns.name: well_type
columns.description: Role of the wellbore that day: `OP` oil producer, `WI` water injector (`WELL_TYPE`). Can change over a wellbore's life.

wells.description: One row per wellbore in the Volve field: its identifiers and the field and facility it belongs to. Seven wellbores, all produced through the Mærsk Inspirer production unit.

columns.name: npd_wellbore_code
columns.description: Wellbore identifier assigned by the Norwegian Offshore Directorate (NPD). The key every production row joins on.

columns.name: wellbore_code
columns.description: Equinor's wellbore code, prefixed with the country (e.g. `NO 15/9-F-12 H`).

columns.name: wellbore_name
columns.description: NPD wellbore name (e.g. `15/9-F-12`): licence block 15/9, platform slot F, well 12. Use this to label wells.

columns.name: npd_field_code
columns.description: NPD field identifier. The same value on every row: Volve.

columns.name: npd_field_name
columns.description: Field name: `VOLVE` on every row.

columns.name: npd_facility_code
columns.description: NPD identifier of the facility the wellbore produced through.

columns.name: npd_facility_name
columns.description: Facility the wellbore produced through: the `MÆRSK INSPIRER` jack-up production unit on every row.

monthly_production.description: Monthly volumes per wellbore, from Equinor's monthly production report. One row per `(date, npd_wellbore_code)`, where `date` is the first day of the month. Volumes are in standard cubic metres (Sm³).

columns.name: date
columns.description: First day of the month the volumes cover, built from the source `Year` and `Month`. Stored in the Parquet file as a timestamp.

columns.name: npd_wellbore_code
columns.description: Wellbore the row belongs to. Joins to `wells`.

columns.name: on_stream_hours
columns.description: Hours the wellbore was on stream in the month (`On Stream`).

columns.name: oil_volume_sm3
columns.description: Oil produced in the month, in Sm³ (`Oil`).

columns.name: gas_volume_sm3
columns.description: Gas produced in the month, in Sm³ (`Gas`).

columns.name: water_volume_sm3
columns.description: Water produced in the month, in Sm³ (`Water`).

columns.name: gas_injection_sm3
columns.description: Gas injected in the month, in Sm³ (`GI`). Empty in every row of the source.

columns.name: water_injection_sm3
columns.description: Water injected in the month, in Sm³ (`WI`).
